h1: The 5 Best TV Stands with Storage of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best TV Stands with Storage: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: five TV stands with cabinets, drawers and shelves compared on TV size, storage layout and weight capacity for living rooms.
summary: The Giantex 55 to 70 inch stand with soft-close cabinets is the best overall. The Tribesigns 70.8 inch suits very large TVs, the JUSTOGO adds drawers and power, the Giantex Rustic is the farmhouse option, and the Giantex 55 inch is the compact budget pick.
intro: The storage on a TV stand is only useful if it holds what you actually own. A stand with three shelves and no closed cabinets leaves cables and game boxes on display, while one with tiny drawers hides almost nothing.

We ranked five stands with storage using the spec sheets, looking at TV size range, storage layout and stated weight capacities. Each pick names the storage it offers, so you can decide whether closed cabinets or open shelves match your gear.

products.name: Giantex TV Stand for 55-70 Inch TV, Modern Entertainment Center with 3 Open Shelves, 2 Soft-Close Side Cabinets and Drawer
products.verdict: A balanced mix of open and closed storage.
products.description:
This Giantex stand fits 55 to 70 inch TVs and has 3 open center shelves, 2 soft-close side cabinets and a drawer. It is engineered wood in a two-tone finish, in the $50-100 bracket.

It ranks first because the mix of open shelves for consoles and closed cabinets for clutter suits most living rooms, and it costs less than the stands below. It lists no weight capacity, unlike the Tribesigns.

Buy it for a mid to large TV. Check the weight limit on the product page.

products.name: Tribesigns 70.8 Inch Long TV Stand for 65/70/75 Inch TVs, Storage Cabinets & Shelves
products.verdict: The longest stand, with stated load ratings.
products.description:
The Tribesigns is 70.8 inches wide and fits 65 to 80 inch TVs. It has concealed cabinets and an open center shelf, with 250 lbs overall capacity, 35 lbs per shelf and a reinforced center support leg.

It ranks second because it is the only stand here that names an overall capacity and sizes for 80 inch TVs. It costs $100-200 and takes more floor space than the Giantex.

Choose it for a 75 inch screen.
products.skipIf: The wall is under 6 feet wide.

products.name: JUSTOGO TV Stand with Mount and Power Outlet, TV Stand with Drawers Storage for 45-65 Inch TVs
products.verdict: Drawers, a mount and four outlets.
products.description:
The JUSTOGO has 2 open shelves, 3 removable drawers, 4 power outlets and a built-in mount with 3 height levels and a 35 degree swivel each way. It lists TVs from 32 to 65 inches and includes anti-tip hardware.

It ranks third because the mount adds complexity and the capacity is not stated. It is the only pick here with built-in outlets.

Buy it if you want everything in one unit. It costs $100-200.
products.idealFor: People who want a one-box setup.

products.name: Giantex Rustic 65 Inch Entertainment Center with Pull-Out Drawer, Cabinet and 3 Shelves
products.verdict: A farmhouse look with a pull-out drawer.
products.description:
The Giantex Rustic fits TVs up to 65 inches and has 1 pull-out drawer, 1 cabinet and 3 open shelves. Its weathered wood-grain look and barn-style hardware set it apart, and the body is engineered wood.

It ranks fourth because it holds fewer sizes than the first two and lists no weight ratings. Style is the reason to choose it.

It suits a rustic living room. It costs $100-200.

products.name: Giantex TV Stand for TV up to 55 Inch, 2 Drawers, Solid Wood Legs, White
products.verdict: A small white stand for 55 inch TVs.
products.description:
This Giantex is sized for TVs of 55 inches or less and has two drawers faced in fabric, wooden legs and a white look. It is compact, in the $50-100 bracket.

It ranks last because it holds the least. It is the best fit for a bedroom or small apartment.

Buy it if a 55 inch TV is your limit.
products.skipIf: You own a TV over 55 inches.

whatMatters.detail: A stand should be at least as wide as your TV. The Tribesigns is 70.8 inches wide for 65 to 80 inch screens, while the compact Giantex is for 55 inches. Measure your TV's width, not just the diagonal.
Open shelves suit game consoles and streaming boxes that need airflow, while closed cabinets hide clutter. A mix like the Giantex 55-70 is a good balance. Check how many of each the listing names.
The top surface must support your TV. Only the Tribesigns lists 250 lbs overall and 35 lbs per shelf. If a listing does not state it, check the full product page.
Soft-close hinges avoid slams and wear. Drawers keep small items tidy but hold less than cabinets. Look for named hinges in the title.
Back panels with gaps make cabling easier. Built-in outlets, as on the JUSTOGO, cut the clutter. Look for cord ports in the listing.

faq.q: How wide should a TV stand be?
faq.a: Wider than your TV, ideally with a few inches to spare on each side. Measure the TV's width, not the diagonal.

faq.q: Can I put a heavy TV on any of these?
faq.a: Check the weight rating on the product page. Only the Tribesigns lists an overall 250 lb capacity in our data.

faq.q: Is the JUSTOGO worth it over the Giantex 55-70?
faq.a: If you want outlets and a built-in mount, yes. For plain storage the Giantex is simpler and cheaper.
Plan an hour and a helper for the bigger stands. Anchor it with the supplied anti-tip hardware where included.
Wipe engineered wood with a damp cloth and dry it. Avoid soaking.
Yes, in homes with children. The JUSTOGO ships with it.

finalTake: The Giantex 55-70 stand is the best all-round pick, with soft-close cabinets and open shelves for $50-100. The Tribesigns is the one for 75 inch TVs, and the JUSTOGO is the feature-packed choice. For small rooms, the Giantex 55 inch is enough.
